rationale_md: Spain enters this Group H encounter as overwhelming favorites, backed by a substantial 310-point Elo rating advantage that reflects the gulf in class between the European powerhouse and the island nation. The model assigns La Roja better than three-in-four odds to secure all three points, with Cape Verde's chances of even earning a draw sitting in the low single digits. Spain's technical superiority and tournament pedigree should prove decisive against a Cape Verde side making what would be a historic World Cup appearance.
